querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      s_segment_item,
                                      s_segment_cost_ratio,
                                      s_segment_profit_ratio,
                                      s_segment_sales_ratio,
                                      s_report_period,
                                      s_crncy_code,
                                      s_segment_sales,
                                      s_segment_profit,
                                      s_segment_itemcode,
                                      s_segment_cost,
                                      s_grossprofitmargin,
                                      s_prime_oper_rev_yoy,
                                      s_prime_oper_cost_yoy,
                                      s_gross_profit_margin_yoy,
                                      s_segment_item_code,
                                      s_segment_sales_code,
                                      s_accounts_id,
                                      s_is_publishvalue,
                                      s_gross_profit_yoy,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cbondsalessegment.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cbondsalessegment WHERE s_report_period BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
